messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Problem hierarchical model Rstan
parts:
I'd suggest the same thing as Daniel. Instead of making it
more complicated, get it working on a simple version of the model
with no time series to the errors. Then add the time series.
The log scale makes the whole model different, but it's easy to
code --- we have lognormal built in.

I'd also recommend reading our prior suggestions on the Stan
wiki and in the manual regression chapter. We don't recommend
those diffuse gamma versions. You can just parameterize directly
with scales rather than inverse square root of precision.

Your loglogistic cdf isn't on the log scale. Are you sure that's
what you want?

- Bob
